subject: general
question: The success of the Green Revolution was dependent on institutional support. Which organisation played a key role in agricultural research and the dissemination of HYV seeds in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research)** is an autonomous organization under the Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.
 
• It played a pivotal role in the success of the Green Revolution by spearheading agricultural research and promoting the use of High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds in India.
 
• ICAR was instrumental in collaborating with international organizations
